Definition: Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Beeroth Bene-Jaakan or Beeroth = "wells" or "wells of the sons of Jaakan"; 1) an encampment for Israel in the wilderness probably in the country of the Horites
